scripts.preview:checkout: npm run build:preview && wrangler preview --config wrangler.checkout-preview.jsonc
scripts.check:deploy: npm run build && XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler/config WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/check-deploy.log WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run
scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/store.test.cjs tests/checkout.test.mjs tests/preview.test.cjs tests/cancellation.test.mjs tests/custom-quote.test.mjs tests/turnstile.test.mjs tests/deployment-config.test.mjs tests/edge-entrypoints.test.cjs tests/release-migrations.test.cjs tests/production-sql-drafts.test.cjs tests/resend-diagnostic.test.mjs tests/seller-scheduler.test.mjs
scripts.check:release: npm run build:release && XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler/config WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/check-deploy.log WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run
